problem: "In one compartment the cation membrane lets cations out and the anion membrane blocks them" — "them" is ambiguous; a student may read it as the anion membrane blocking anions, which is the opposite of what an anion-exchange membrane does.
fix: "In one compartment the cation-exchange membrane lets cations leave towards the cathode, and the anion-exchange membrane stops them leaving on the other side, so this compartment loses salt."

problem: "A module never converts all the feed" uses "converts" loosely; the chapter has just defined the correct term, recovery, and mixing the two words confuses the definition.
fix: "A module never turns all the feed into product. The fraction recovered as product is the recovery, and the rest leaves as brine."

problem: The electrodialysis cell gives a control method ('polarity reversal') where the reverse-osmosis cell gives fouling types ('scale and biofouling'); the two halves of the row do not compare the same thing.
fix: Make both cells list fouling types, for example: RO — "scale, biofouling"; ED — "scale on membrane faces, organic fouling; controlled by polarity reversal"

problem: "Electrodialysis reverses into electrodialysis reversal for difficult feeds" reads as if the stack turns into a different process; polarity reversal is an operating mode of the same stack.
fix: "Running a stack with periodic polarity reversal is called electrodialysis reversal (EDR), and it is used for difficult feeds."
